text: Access from station-01 to Faculty Residences & International Hostel Towers is constrained along NH-05 Main University Arterial (Ludhiana-Chandigarh Hwy Access), Sports Arena & South Transit Spur over a 405.7m route. Available carriageway width is narrow relative to the required 3.5m clearance for Fire tender. Passage is possible with reduced operating margins and caution.
